words.gloss: he who lives in the home

literal: He who lives in the home, he who is called, to all three who possess nature, in the good path standing support.
translation: He who is called a householder is a steadfast support in the good path for the three other orders who possess their own natural duties.
modern: இல்வாழ்க்கையில் வாழ்பவன் என்று சிறப்பித்துச் சொல்லப்படுபவன், தத்தம் இயல்புகளை உடைய மற்ற மூன்று நிலையினருக்கும் நல்வழியில் நிலைத்திருக்கும் துணையாவான்.
explanation: This couplet defines the fundamental role of the householder in society. The word 'இல்வாழ்வான்' refers to the one who leads a domestic life, while 'மூவர்' refers to the three other stages of life who rely on him. By providing for them, the householder stands as a steadfast support ('நின்ற துணை') in the path of virtue. The term 'ஆறு' here means path or way, specifically the virtuous path of life.
